observations: body L1: the first two digits of «٢٢٤» have one crest each (2); the 4 is the F-shaped sort.
body L4: the shadda and the fatḥa of «عَشِيَّاتٌ» are cast as one sign (4.4 by 4.2 points).

body L5: «مُغَيْربَنَاتِ» is printed with the bāʾ joined to the nūn, without an alif between them (one alif, before the final tāʾ); the rāʾ has no vowel sign. «الشمس» is printed with an elongated join (kashīda), not transcribed.

body L7, L8, L9, L11, L12: «العَشِيَّاتِ» (L7) and «العشيَّات» (L12) have a fatḥa with the shadda; «العشيّات» in L8, L9 and L11 has the shadda alone. «اِخْتِفَاءُ» (L7) ends in the hamza sort with the damma (4.1 by 5.2 points) and is printed with a kashīda; «غروب» (L9) is printed with a kashīda; not transcribed.
body L11: «طُلُوع» has dammas on the ṭāʾ and the lām and no vowel sign on the ʿayn.
body L13: the reference «(١٨{5}» has two digits (the 1 and the 8, 4.1 points); the other references of the line have three.
body L13, L14: «العضادتَانِ» (L13) and «الطويلتَانِ» (L14) have a fatḥa on the tāʾ and a kasra under the final nūn; «الطَّوِيلَة» (L13) has no vowel sign on the tāʾ marbūṭa.

body L15, L16, L17: «عَقْدٌ» (L15) has a fatḥa on the ʿayn, «عُقْدَةٌ» a damma; «عُقْدَتان» (L16) has its fatḥa on the dāl and no vowel sign on the tāʾ or the nūn; «عَقْدَانِ» and «عَقْد» (L17) have the fatḥa.
body L17: the second digit of «٨٣» has two crests (a 3, 3.9 points wide).
body L18: «عقدة» before «الرَّأْس» is unvowelled; «عُقْدَة الذَّنَب» has no vowel sign on the tāʾ marbūṭa.
body L25: the last digit of «١٠٢» has one crest (a 2, 2.9 points). «٢١٨–٢١٩» and «٢٢٠–٢٢١» are printed with en dashes (5.5 points), «7-8» with a hyphen (3.4 points).
body L26: the sign above the alif of «آمِرٌ» is the madda (3.5 by 1.8 points).
body L29, L30: «الأَعِنَّةِ» (L29) has a kasra under the tāʾ marbūṭa, «الأَعِنَّة» (L30) none; «مُمْسِك» (L30) has no vowel sign on the kāf.
body L31, L34: «Αἴξ» is printed with the smooth breathing and the acute cast together over the iota, as over «ἔ» of «ἔριφοι» (L34).
body L31, L36: «Capella (α Aurigae)» (L36) is printed in roman type, unlike «Capella, α Aurigae» in L31.
notes_left L3: the first digit of «292» is printed with a blot over the 2; transcribed as the figure.
notes_right L2: the second Arabic phrase is «من العصريات»: «من» stands at the right of «العصريات», before «dans».
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
